[size=150][b]Lionheart Fixt 0.9.3 - repairs[/b][/size]

Repair only. Two fixes from the second playthrough.

The fish monger's [i]Vodyanoi Anatomist[/i] perk -- fifteen skulls for the soft spot behind the eye
-- did nothing, however you fought. Now every landed hit on a vodyanoi does an extra 4-10
piercing damage, shown as its own number, with fists, blades, bows or spells alike.

And the goblin in Scar Ravine no longer answers the Strength and Barter routes as if you'd
invoked the Khan.

[b]Fixt[/b] is a cumulative restoration-and-repair mod for Lionheart, after Fallout Fixt.

Download, unzip, run [i]Mod Manager.bat[/i]. Works on any save; the perk from the next vodyanoi you
meet.
